S3 — Outcome: list pagination follows the existing paginator and its partial last page is checked; fact: its current floor calculation drops a partial page, and Q2 and Q4 settle the interface and page size. S4 — Boundary: retain zero dependencies and a simple implementation. S5 — Outcome: users persist across restart while the in-memory store remains active; discovery or the Q6 default settles storage and concurrency behavior. S6 — Boundary: run improve until a pass finds only trivial changes, fan handler and test work out in parallel, and code-review before completion; Q14 checks whether those workflows are available. S9 — Fact: GET /users returns an array of user objects; Q3 records the assumed response shape for new operations pending discovery. Delivery visibility: the requested result becomes usable through this repository's HTTP API after implementation and final return; an isolated run's source checkout remains at its snapshot until then, and any deployed outcome exists only after a separately identified release.
